messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] Airflow Providers - release preparation date 2026-07-22
messages.body:
Hello,

Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-07-22 have been accepted, with
exclusions listed below.

4 "+1" binding votes received:
- Shahar Epstein
- Wei Lee
- Jarek Potiuk
- Rahul Vats

4 "+1" non-binding votes received:
- Jason Liu
- Andrew Chang
- Aaron Chen
- Sameer Mesiah (for snowflake and celery)

The following providers have been excluded from the release and won't be
included in an accelerated ad-hoc release:
- common.ai - unreadiness (-1 binding from Shahar Epstein)
- clickhousedb - no user facing changes (-1 binding from Shahar Epstein)

The following providers have been excluded due to regressions found in the
testing phase, and may be included in an accelerated ad-hoc release once
fixed:
- google (-1 binding from Shahar Epstein)
- openlineage (-1 binding from Shahar Epstein, -1 non-binding from Sameer
Mesiah) - there's already a fix on its way (
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70452)

Vote thread:
https://lists.apache.org/thread/vvyqvchw8vwph58cwcrcg8sd5jojbpzd

I'll continue with the release process, and the release announcement will
follow shortly afterwards.

Thank you,


Shahar Epstein
